title: ShippingCode
description:
How to hand a booked shipment over to the carrier, for shipping options that have no printable
freight label (for example Instabox) or that are handed over by scanning a QR code.

orderId.description: The order the shipment belongs to.

shippingProvider.description: The shipping provider that carries the shipment, for example Instabox or SchenkerPrivpak.

labellessShippingCode.description:
The code to write on the parcel for a labelless shipment. Empty until the carrier has
confirmed the booking, and for shipping options that use a printed freight label instead.

qrCodeImageUrl.description: URL to a QR code to show at drop-off. Empty for shipping options that do not use one.

hasFreightLabel.description:
Whether a printable freight label is available for the shipment through the freight-labels
endpoint.
